selection: Validation-only full-model MAE chooses common M3 weight; M2 reference setting separately selected by validation MAE for B23 and B123. At weight0 use original frozen setting and audit original predictions.
acceptance: Original eight-group all-dataset all-metric independent/incremental/complementarity gates
limits: Separate new candidate, not replacement of selected v3
